kind: Local PostgreSQL runtime / contract fixtures, never Cloud

checks.name: Catalog export is one read-only metadata JSON with no user data/function bodies
Unapproved release fails before changing the local schema
An existing RPC overload is preserved and blocks conflicting new RPC deployment
Inherited client EXECUTE aborts release without changing provider defaults or installing objects
Approved release executes on the compatible local contract schema
Release narrows postgres/public defaults while leaving internal provider defaults exactly unchanged
Postflight passes with provider defaults intact and detects an effective grant regression
Regions migration requires its own approval, preserves UUIDs and rejects invalid parents
Release preserves pre-existing content/settings and their original values
Public config remains SELECT-only under broad default grants
Backup/quota remain private despite managed default grants
Assigned role labels resolve without granting administrative writes
Manager/editor writes obey actual table RLS and public publication filters
Staff/settings/queue RPCs execute with server RBAC and bounded contracts
Service-only submission persists report, receipt hash and initial history
Reason NULL succeeds; blank/overflow rejected; update/history are atomic on failure
Tracking rejects a foreign token and does not expose private report fields
Last Super Admin is protected and rate quotas enforce durable client bounds
Private evidence policy blocks even an existing permissive storage policy
Repeat release fails closed without replacing existing objects/data
Rollback refuses later table grants/policy changes instead of overwriting them
Rollback restores the original review body/ACL and preserves app data/evidence
Repeated rollback/release after recovery stop safely and preserve retained data

limitations: Auth/storage schemas are fixtures, not external services
No concurrent-session or real JWT acceptance
engine: PostgreSQL 18.6 (PGlite 0.5.12) on wasm32-unknown-emscripten, compiled by emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 3.1.74 (1092ec30a3fb1d46b1782ff1b4db5094d3d06ae5), 32-bit
